Model Routing

Directing requests to suitable models or deployments using explicit rules and permitted fallbacks.

In practice

Extraction, image understanding and final review can need different capabilities. Check input type, output format, budget and privacy for each step.

What to check

Capability selection, service health and data destination are distinct concerns. Record the actual model and deployment, not only an alias.

Common confusion

A common API does not ensure equal capabilities. A failure does not authorize sending data to another provider.
